tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground and the ballot sheet inside a violet frame.

tokens.name: paper-tint
tokens.usage: Alternate bands (endorsements, vote result panel). Same text tokens as paper.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body copy, ballot questions and statements on paper and paper-tint (17:1 light, 18:1 dark).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Fine print, timestamps, placeholder text on paper and paper-tint (7.8:1 or better).

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: The ballot ink: headlines, labels, rules, ballot boxes, outline buttons and links on paper (7.9:1 light, 6.8:1 dark).

tokens.name: violet-deep
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state for violet links and outline buttons.

tokens.name: violet-soft
tokens.usage: Notice keys (WHO, MISSION, GOAL) on paper, so the values lead. 5:1 on white.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Solid violet fill: poster frames, status bar, footer, callout bars. Same in both themes; text on it is on-field.

tokens.name: on-field
tokens.usage: Text and marks on field (7.9:1).

tokens.name: on-field-accent
tokens.usage: The red note on a violet field: the full stop after an ask, the live dot, the reversed check. Graphic or 24px+ text only (3.5:1).

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: The NO. Display words, the checked NO box, the vote button fill. On paper it is 4.2:1, so red text is 24px+ or bold 19px+ only.

tokens.name: red-ink
tokens.usage: Red text under 19px (receipt, inline emphasis) and vote button hover. 5.3:1 on white.

tokens.name: on-red
tokens.usage: Text on a red fill. Vote button text stays 19px bold or larger.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between notice rows. Decorative only; structural rules use violet.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 3px solid with 3px offset, on paper and paper-tint. On field, use on-field.

styles.name: t-display-xl
styles.usage: One per page: the hero line. Uppercase. Scales down to 48px on phones.

styles.name: t-title
styles.usage: Notice values, card titles. Sentence case.

styles.name: t-ui
styles.usage: Buttons, nav, the wordmark at small sizes.

styles.name: t-label
styles.usage: Eyebrows, form headers, status bar. Uppercase.

styles.name: t-question
styles.sample: Should an open social protocol depend on the permission of a single company?
styles.usage: The ballot question. Always a real yes/no question.

styles.name: t-lead
styles.sample: A door is not an exit if someone else holds the key.
styles.usage: The one-paragraph statement under a headline.

styles.name: t-body
styles.sample: Make essential infrastructure open and permissionless.
styles.usage: Running text, measures, updates. Keep lines near 65 characters.

styles.name: t-small
styles.sample: One tap. No wallet, no sign-up.
styles.usage: Fine print on ballots and receipts.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Inside receipts, between label and value.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon to text, tight lists.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button groups, rule padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Grid gaps, button padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding, page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Ballot padding, gaps inside a section.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Hero top padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Large posters and screens only.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Everything rectangular: buttons, ballots, cards, frames. Ballot paper has square corners.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Round things only: the sticker, endorsement badges, the play button, the live dot.

stroke.note: Borders carry the system. No shadows on boxes.

tokens.name: stroke-rule
tokens.usage: Row dividers, update rows.

tokens.name: stroke-box
tokens.usage: Cards, outline buttons, small ballot boxes.

tokens.name: stroke-heavy
tokens.usage: The ballot form, its header rule, the site header rule, large check boxes.

tokens.name: stroke-frame
tokens.usage: Violet frame around a ballot sheet on the web. Posters use about 5% of the short side.

tokens.name: shadow-sticker
tokens.usage: Only on stickers and endorsement badges: things slapped onto the page. Apply to a PNG with filter: drop-shadow().

layout.note: Plain CSS values used by the components.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max content width of the site.

tokens.name: sticker-tilt
tokens.usage: Default sticker rotation. Allowed range -6deg to -8deg.
